_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Resort Info card: elevation, lifts, runs, skiable area, season dates, ski passes (not snow conditions)

description: INTERACTIVE RESORT GUIDE CARD (Resort Info sidebar UI) — elevation, vertical, lifts, runs, skiable acres, average snowfall, season dates, ski passes, editorial description, hero/gallery carousel. REQUIRED when the user asks for: resort guide, mountain profile, resort info, lifts/runs/vertical/skiable area, season dates, ski passes, or "tell me about the mountain" (non-weather). Answers single-resort stat questions: base/summit elevation, vertical drop, skiable area, average annual snowfall. Examples: "Aspen Mountain resort guide", "how many lifts at Jackson Hole", "what is the base elevation at Arapahoe Basin". For X-vs-Y stat questions use compare_resorts. Do NOT use get_resort (that shows the snow conditions card).

resort.description: Same as `slug`: the resort slug or name. Pass either one.

slug.description: Resort slug or name, e.g. "portillo" or "Portillo". Required unless `resort` is given.

name: get_resort_info

markdown.description: Human-readable markdown summary (required for ChatGPT Instant mode).

resort.description: Structured resort payload for inline widget rendering.
